dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the mid-lateral flank exhibit irregular, high-contrast light-colored perimeters with a sharp gradient transition to dark, recessed interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid-fill light pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, localized primarily in the neck region and interspersed among larger annuli on the upper lateral body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct macro-annuli on the mid-flank form an obtuse triangular spatial relationship, with smaller high-intensity blobs forming a secondary curvilinear alignment extending toward the posterior.
